devdoc.details: Implementation of a strategy to get yields from farming LP Pools in the JetFuel platform. This strat is currently compatible with all LP pools.

StratHarvest(address).details: Event that is fired each time someone harvests the strat.

balanceOf().details: Function to calculate the total underlaying {lpPair} held by the strat. It takes into account both the funds in hand, as the funds allocated in the MasterFuel.

balanceOfLpPair().details: It calculates how much {lpPair} the contract holds.

balanceOfPool().details: It calculates how much {lpPair} the strategy has allocated in the MasterFuel

constructor.details: Initializes the strategy with the token to maximize.

deposit().details: Function that puts the funds to work. It gets called whenever someone deposits in the strategy's vault contract. It deposits {lpPair} in the MasterFuel to farm {fuel}

harvest().details: Core function of the strat, in charge of collecting and re-investing rewards. 1. It claims rewards from the MasterFuel. 2. It charges the system fees to simplify the split. 3. It swaps the {fuel} token for {lpToken0} & {lpToken1} 4. Adds more liquidity to the pool. 5. It deposits the new LP tokens.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

panic().details: Pauses deposits. Withdraws all funds from the MasterFuel, leaving rewards behind

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

retireStrat().details: Function that has to be called as part of strat migration. It sends all the available funds back to the vault, ready to be migrated to the new strat.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdraw(uint256).details: Withdraws funds and sents them back to the vault. It withdraws {lpPair} from the MasterFuel. The available {lpPair} minus fees is returned to the vault.

REWARDS_FEE.details: Distribution of fees earned. This allocations relative to the % implemented on chargeFees(). Current implementation separates 6% for fees. {REWARDS_FEE} - 4% goes to JETS holders through the JETS contract. {CALL_FEE} - 0.5% goes to whoever executes the harvest function as gas subsidy. {TREASURY_FEE} - 1.5% goes to the treasury. {MAX_FEE} - Aux const used to safely calc the correct amounts. {WITHDRAWAL_FEE} - Fee taxed when a user withdraws funds. 50 === 0.5% fee. {WITHDRAWAL_MAX} - Aux const used to safely calc the correct amounts.

fuelToWbnbRoute.details: Routes we take to swap tokens using the configured unirouter. {fuelToWbnbRoute} - Route we take to get from {fuel} into {wbnb}. {wbnbToFuelRoute} - Route we take to get from {wbnb} into {fuel}. {fuelToLp0Route} - Route we take to get from {fuel} into {lpToken0}. {fuelToLp1Route} - Route we take to get from {fuel} into {lpToken1}.

masterFuel.details: Third Party Contracts: {masterFuel} - MasterFuel contract. Stake Tokens, get rewards. {unirouter} - Strategy unirouter {poolId} - MasterFuel pool id

rewards.details: jetfuel Contracts: {rewards} - Reward pool where the strategy fee earnings will go. {treasury} - Address of the Jetfuel Finance treasury {vault} - Address of the vault that controls the strategy's funds.

wbnb.details: Tokens Used: {wbnb} - Required for liquidity routing when doing swaps. {fuel} - Token generated by staking our funds. In this case it's the {fuel} token. {lpPair} - Token that the strategy maximizes. The same token that users deposit in the vault. {lpToken0, lpToken1} - Tokens that the strategy maximizes. IUniswapV2Pair tokens
